about: Owner-declared entries of the v6 deploy gates (gate_policy.py --declared), read by both v6 policies: policy_v6_rt_mcp.json (POST /resolve, POST /traverse, GET /traverse/capabilities) and policy_v6_rtp_mcp.json (the same routes and POST /pattern, the owner's decision 2 of 2026-10-16, if the v6 baseline shows /pattern decisive). v6 (the owner, 2026-10-15 / -16) is v5 with every default-budget /pattern request at 110,000 ms instead of 60,000 (not 120,000: the public ingress cuts at ~120 s), with round 2's /pattern MCP marks, budget_stress tags and warm-ups; the scenarios the rt gate selects are byte-identical to v5's with their warm repeats, so the v5 acceptance (the baseline run 20261015T161813Z_refseq97-81c620ef) carries over. What the MCP surface cannot show is classed in the manifest itself, as in v5: C-caps-0001 mcp.not_implemented; label_dict_contains of the T-labels pairs mcp.not_implemented_checks; T-edge-0008 by design through traverse.duplicate_seeds; the long walks' budget_stress tag (T-longwalk-0001..0004); and for /pattern the property marks of round 2, the six heavy scenarios' budget_stress tag and the warm-ups' (gate_policy derives the exclusions). Declared here: one relation the MCP arm can never evaluate because the service refuses one side by design (REL-subset-0007); it lies outside the rt gate's selection, so only the rtp policy reads it. declared_v5_rt.json stays v5's.

relations_excluded.reason: service-side by design (round 2, the owner's decision 4 of 2026-10-16): its side b, P-modes-0004, sends max_contexts 10,001, which the service refuses at submit by the by-design table's case pattern.max_contexts_above_10000 (pattern_out_of_bounds on caps.max_contexts; the host clamps the value to 10,000 and answers, the service never lowers it), so P-modes-0002's partial list can never be held within P-modes-0004's on the MCP arm (the v5 baseline: inconclusive, http 200 / 400). P-modes-0004's own MCP execution stays required as the named by-design case, and the relation stays required on direct-local, where both sides answer.
